page.overview:
Who is Cranberry Stockings?

is a Christmas elf cleric played by Marisha Ray for .

Cranberry Stockings has a full beard with a mustache. Both her hair and beard are dual-colored. The divide between red and green runs exactly in the middle parting of her hair.

Cranberry Stockings likes to keep it traditional, but prefers to keep her own flair on it, with a little bit of half and half (in reference to her beard). She has an Upper Midwestern accent.
